description: Role-based access policy for Northwind (fictional). Provisioning grants only what is listed here. Anything else a user holds is an exception that must survive an access review.

sod_rules.name: Create vendors and approve payments
sod_rules.risk: One person could add a fake vendor and approve payment to it.

sod_rules.name: Process and administer payroll
sod_rules.risk: One person could change pay rates and run the payroll that pays them.

sod_rules.name: Write code and administer production
sod_rules.risk: Code can reach production without independent review.
sod_rules.mitigating_control: Allowed for SRE when every production change goes through a reviewed pull request and break-glass access is logged.
